title: La série de visuels
intro: Dix visuels par marque : la personne, une bande, le produit seul. Trois références par image : visage, produit, pose réelle.

jobs.label: remblai
jobs.prompt:
Reference images, in order:
1. ANNABELLE: the brand muse, casting reference for the model's look.
2. PRODUCT: an exact sling colourway to reproduce (construction, colours, round embroidered patch).
3. POSE AND REALISM REFERENCE: a real surf photograph; copy only the natural way a real surfer walks and holds a board, true proportions and real light. Do not copy the person or colours.

ANNABELLE (first reference image, the brand muse): same look as in the casting photo: SHORT curly brown hair (chin-length ringlets, never long or straight), large tortoiseshell glasses always on, warm smile, olive skin, natural body.

HOW THE PRODUCT IS WORN: the longboard passes THROUGH the loop of the sling, the canvas panel wraps the middle of the board (upper part of the panel visible over the board), the two straps rise over the shoulder, the board hangs horizontally at the hip, nose forward. Never carried like a tote bag beside the board.

ANNABELLE CLUB brand, Les Sables-d'Olonne, summer: pop 1970s colour photography in the manner of Martin Parr and Lartigue, hard daylight with fill flash, saturated Kodachrome colours, deadpan humour. The Remblai promenade with its row of white beach cabins, bright morning. Annabelle, in a striped terry-cloth top and white shorts, laughs as she walks toward the camera carrying a longboard in the striped Pare-vent sling; a vintage bicycle leans on the railing. Subject on the right third, open sky on the left.

Realism: a real photograph, natural skin texture, real fabric creases, correct hands with five fingers, the board at true scale (about 9 feet). Negative: no text, no extra logos, no watermark, no CGI look, no plastic skin, no stock-photo posing.
